notes: ACCESS: Retry of a prior attempt that crashed mid-task from an unrelated infra error (not a site block). Confirmed no dedicated /in/ path exists for India; the market-select splash at https://www.zarahome.com/ww/ (with Market pre-set to India, Language English) resolves India to the WW (Worldwide) store, matching the brief's carried-forward finding. Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl, chrome UA) got an Akamai Bot Manager interstitial JS-challenge shell (~2KB meta-refresh + sensor script) on the homepage - insufficient for parsing. robots.txt at the domain root is genuinely empty (200, 0 bytes) - no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, no blanket 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /', so no tier is policy-blocked. Escalated to tier (b): headed Playwright Chromium with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled (the fix that cleared Akamai for the sibling Zara Home locale sites UAE/UK/DE/ES/FR) passed the challenge cleanly on the first attempt and loaded the real Angular-SSR WW site; session cookies persisted via storage_state across subsequent page loads. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. The market-select page required an explicit 'GO' button click, then a one-time 'HELLO, Yes continue in International' interstitial dismissed via a direct coordinate click on the visible button (text-locator clicks intermittently mis-targeted an overlapping element); after that, the hamburger flyout menu (.left-container__menu-icon) exposed the full nav. TREE: built the union of (1) the flyout mega-menu (BEDDING, HOME DECOR, BATHROOM, KIDS AND BABY, LAUNDRY CARE - each opened and its full sub-panel captured; CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR is pure apparel and CULINARY STORIES is pure recipe/editorial content, both out of scope and not further explored) and (2) the WW-locale category XML sitemap (https://www.zarahome.com/8/info/sitemaps/sitemap-home-categories-zh-ww-0.xml.gz, 460 URLs), which surfaced additional real leaves not shown in the flyout (Bed Linen > Basics > Cotton Percale/Linen/Sateen Cotton, Bedspreads > Summer Bedspreads, Quilts > Duvets). WW is confirmed to be a reduced 'worldwide fallback' catalog versus the AE/UK/DE/ES/FR locale sites already in this project - it has no Kitchen & Dining nav group, no Rugs category, and no dedicated Kids Storage section at all (verified absent from both the flyout and the sitemap). kids-bedroom-decoration-n1119 (a sitemap URL) redirects to /ww/error.html 'PAGE UNAVAILABLE' - dead, skipped. Parent/See-all aggregator pages were skipped per the Parent Category URL Rule wherever real subcategories exist (bedding/bed-linen-c1020235001.html, bedding/bed-linen/basics/see-all-c1020446923.html, kids-bedding-n1097 and its ?celement= variant which renders the identical unfiltered 24-item page, bathroom-accessories-n2470, home-decor-n989, laundry-care-n1399). QTY: this template shows no explicit 'N products' counter; qty = the count of article.product-item cards after programmatically scrolling to the bottom repeatedly until the count was stable across 3+ consecutive checks (site's own exact rendered count). Two categories (Bedding>Quilts>Duvets/'Winter duvets' and Kids and Baby>Bedding>Filling & Protectors) loaded correctly (breadcrumb, H1, filter/sort controls, and an on-page 'The category X has been opened' confirmation all present) but rendered zero product cards after repeated stabilization checks across two separate visits - recorded as a genuine qty=0, not a load failure. EXCLUDED and why: bathroom-bins-n3827 ('Functional bathroom bins' - waste/trash bins, not storage/organization containers, matching the SR21/UAE precedent for the identical listing); hooks-n4857 ('Clothing Hooks and Hangers' - hardware for hanging clothes/coats, not in storage.md's covered product list, matching the SR21 precedent excluding kids-hangers); bedding>Dressing Room's Hangers and Furniture children (Hangers = same hardware boundary as above; Furniture = out of scope, Furniture.xlsx's domain); bathroom-accessories-n2470's Bathroom bins/Soap dispensers/Toothbrush holders/Soap dish/Trays children (purely decorative bathroom accessories, Decorative Home Accessories task boundary, not Storage); bathroom-self-care-n1418 (bath/cosmetic products, not textile or storage); laundry-cleaning-n2485 (cleaning products/tools themselves, not storage); vases-decorative-planters-n1010, home-decor-planters-n1402, candle-holders-n1003, door-knobs-handles-n1005, home-decor-n989 'Decorative Accessories' (all Decorative Home Accessories task boundary); kids-decoration-n1123 (children's decorative accessories - wall/room decor, not textile or storage); gift-ideas-special-occasion-baby-n4355 (gift collection landing page); all 'SEE ALL'/'View all' links and both Special Collection / Katharine Pole Selected Prints editorial-collection links (View All / Collection URL rule). Two rows were resolvable but the site itself mixes a textile product with a non-textile one on the exact same listing with no way to isolate a textile-only count, so both were kept at LOW confidence with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than excluded outright (mirroring the SR21/UAE precedent for the near-identical bathroom-bathrobes-n1053 listing): Bathrobes and Slippers (bathrobes=textile, slippers=footwear) and Kids and Baby > Baby > Bathroom (mostly baby towels/muslin cloths=textile, but also brush-and-comb sets and a rubberised bathroom set=non-textile). Curtains and Roller Blinds (home-decor-curtains-blinds-n996) was kept at MEDIUM confidence because the single listing bundles fabric curtains with roller blinds whose material could not be individually confirmed as fabric for every item. bedding/bedspreads/summer-bedspreads-c1020620416.html is filed under the site's own Bedspreads URL path/breadcrumb but its rendered H1 actually reads 'Summer Quilts' - kept under Bedspreads per the URL/nav structure with the H1 discrepancy noted in its evidence field. No Storage candidates outside the Bathroom group were found anywhere in the WW site (no Kitchen/Kids/Office/Living Room storage nav or sitemap entries exist on this reduced catalog).
